headline.text: L1 S2 zip tape found on salt magnet inlet — metal detector *did not detect* piece when QA tested it.

summary: Three active holds: 41 pallets of Canada s'mores on L1 S3 (wrong Best By), 3 pallets on L3 MF Matrix (wrong lot code), and L2 ML2 reviewing pallets after discovering inaccurate scale. Foreign material event on L1 S2 — metal detector failure confirmed.

holds.title: 41 pallets — incorrect Canadian Best By date
holds.summary: MM3 printer froze and reset to USA recipe; 41 pallets from 2nd shift printed with wrong date before operators caught it.
holds.status: On hold — Springville identifying which pallets came from MM3 for rework; MM4/MM5 pallets will be released.

holds.title: 3 pallets — incorrect lot code at MF Matrix setup
holds.summary: Lot code error at startup; first 3 pallets produced before correction placed on hold.

food_safety.title: Zip tape on salt magnet — metal detector did not detect
food_safety.summary: Operator found zip tie piece attached to Hapman salt magnet during inspection; QA passed piece through metal detector and it did not reject.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance confirms zip ties used during decorator pipe cleaning; new plan implemented to prevent recurrence.

food_safety.title: Imperial gasket broke — piece missing into pistons
food_safety.summary: Nozzle plate gasket pulled into pistons during assembly; piece missing, QA inspected and confirmed remainder accounts for all but one small piece.
food_safety.status: Resolved — missing piece cut from original gasket and tested 5x through metal detector, detected each time; confident it will be caught if in product.

food_safety.title: Non-detectable gaskets found in maintenance stock
food_safety.summary: QA sorting through ML1 gasket bag after break event found mixed stock — some gaskets do not pass metal detector.
food_safety.status: Resolved — detectable gaskets separated and given to line; non-detectable gaskets held by QA.

quality.title: Inaccurate checkweigher — previous pallets under review
quality.summary: ML2 case scale discovered not accurate; portable scale moved to line, QA checking previous pallets to determine if rework needed based on pallet weight.
quality.status: Resolved — scale leveled by maintenance and now reading accurately; QA reviewing historical pallets.

sanitation.title: Cavanna #4 allergen test failure during cleaning
sanitation.summary: Metal area where film enters on Cavanna #4 failed allergen verification; operator re-cleaned and passed on second test.
sanitation.status: Resolved — area re-cleaned, passed allergen test at 22:40, released back to production.

opportunities.text: Consider adding zip tie inspection/accountability to decorator pipe cleaning checklist — today's piece on salt magnet was not detected by metal detector and maintenance confirmed similar fasteners used during pipe work.
Review MM3 printer fault recovery procedure — printer froze twice in 24 hours, resetting to wrong recipe each time; second event put 41 pallets on hold.
Add checkweigher accuracy verification to ML2 startup checklist — inaccurate scale discovered mid-shift, requiring pallet review.
Review metal-detectable part verification at receiving — maintenance bag contained mixed gaskets, some non-detectable; supplier QA or incoming inspection gap.
